data.title: Retopologize a deforming elbow
data.summary: A licensed high-resolution arm and a low-resolution target cage. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Blender documents remeshing tools for changing topology while approximating shape.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender / COLMAP / Nerfstudio environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A licensed high-resolution arm and a low-resolution target cage.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent retopology joint workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A licensed high-resolution arm and a low-resolution target cage. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Preserve the source and build clean loops around the elbow on a separate mesh
Use shrinkwrap as an aid while keeping a deliberate loop layout
Weight to a simple two-bone rig and inspect straight, 90 and 130 degree bends

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned retopologize a deforming elbow candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Bending does not collapse the elbow silhouette
The mesh remains connected without accidental doubled vertices
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Automatic projection does not guarantee animation-ready topology.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Evaluate topology in deformation poses, not only in the neutral pose.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me retopologize a deforming elbow in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A licensed high-resolution arm and a low-resolution target cage. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Bending does not collapse the elbow silhouette; The mesh remains connected without accidental doubled vertices. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
